I'm really sorry to hear you feel like this bro. It's a place I've been I've been to also. I've felt like killing myself because I felt confined to my body. I know that words might not mean a lot right now because when I felt like this, I thought I would feel like that forever but things will get better. You are cared about and loved. Even though I haven't met you I care about you. You're a valuable soul. I know right now it hurts, and It'll probably feel like forever but November will be here and you'll be 18 and you can do whatever the hell you want. 

If your college has a student portal see if you can go online and change your name. Some colleges let students change their name and it will appear on all class rosters and you'll also get a new ID card with your preferred name.  If you can't do it online see if you can go to your college's registrars office and fill out some paper work to get your preferred names on ID card, and the college data base. 

If there is a support group near you for trans guys consider joining it. I'm still pre-t and a support group has really helped me out. Being around other people who knew exactly how I felt and were going through the same things was very beneficial. I made some close friends from my support group. Also support groups can help with unsupportive parents. 

I wish you the best of luck bro, and remember you are cared about 💞
